items.original_title: Democrat Peter Crosby Looks to Flip Utah's 2nd District
items.rss_summary: Peter Crosby, Democratic candidate for Utah's 2nd Congressional District, said Congress can vote to reassert its power over tariffs and vote against the war in Iran, which would ease the affordability crisis. Crosby, who is running to unseat Republican congressman Blake Moore, said that the major issues facing the district's constituents are nonpartisan and that 'we have to do something different if we expect different outcomes.'  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.original_title: Exclusive-Pakistan military 'cautiously optimistic' on Iran-US mediation
items.rss_summary: By Rick NoackRAWALPINDI, Pakistan, Oct 30 (Reuters) - Pakistan’s military is “cautiously optimistic” about its mediation between Iran and the United States, its spokesman said on Friday in his first interview since a high-level delegation visited Tehran this week.Army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir — Pakistan's chief mediator in its efforts to de-escalate the now eight-month-old Iran war — has been to Tehran twice this month, most recently on Monday alongside Saudi and Turkish officials.
